reference.reuse: Control/action/expression semantics only. No Anon MOC, textures, keyforms, motion curves or expression files are copied. Anon upper/forearm numeric domains are model-specific; POPY uses independently authored degrees and real skin weights. No independent Anon leg motion parameters were found.

M_Body.method: connected source endpoint collapse; UV seam/link/orientation constraints; sampled real skinning distance

limitations: Single-parameter matrix fields retain finite interpolation and floating-point error
Mean-depth patches, culling and garment order bias approximate intersecting 3D surfaces
Finite-pose validation only; no cloth collision or foot-contact IK
Original collar/hair collision trajectory limitations are retained

native_skinning.method: projected homogeneous bone-matrix products and linear skinning using native parameterized Glue

limitations: Finite pose coverage, no proof of collision-free arbitrary motion
Full-body clothing uses source skinning, no cloth/body collision simulation or foot-contact IK
Mean-depth ArtMesh ordering and inherited head masks approximate 3D occlusion
Expression presets use existing audited facial controls; Anon-specific tears/hearts/sweat/shadows are unsupported
Large MOC/order-keyform memory cost; single-parameter matrix fields retain finite interpolation and float error
No new CMO3 and no official Cubism Editor/Core verification
CPU motion evaluator implements curves, looping, expression blend and clamping; host-level motion crossfades are not part of this offline harness
